_comment: Workbook exercise zone-reheat-saturated (docs/workbook/zone-reheat-saturated.md), ornl-frp-vav part: the ten VAV boxes of set 3's fault-free day only (RTU_VAV_<room>__d3_fault_free), so every cold room found is a real building's normal operation, not a test fault. Same rules as the lbnl-fpu part: reheat_capacity_shortfall, overcooling_severity and unmet_setpoint_hours, at their defaults, with the building's own thermostat schedule and occupancy flag (Table 3 of the data descriptor: 21/24 C occupied 7 a.m.-10 p.m.; the occupancy point replaces the rules' default schedule). The boxes' reheat is electric and published as energy per minute, not a valve or command, so it is not mapped (see mappings/ornl_frp_vav.json): reheat_capacity_shortfall, which needs a reheat valve, cannot judge any box -- the exercise's point. 15-minute resample (one day of 1-minute data).
